sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Quality and cost proposal for Bearing bracket HN (part:310020)
move.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for offer:70140-0. Its quality commitment of 6400 ppm cannot meet our requirement for part:310020, which needs <=1500 ppm. Your scorecard sc:70140@2026Q3 shows 2376 ppm and 63.5% on-time delivery, so we need a binding quality improvement and cost recovery.

Please send a cost breakdown and confirm the earliest lead time. We propose the attached packages, which trade ppm, chargeback and price. The standard chargeback of 0.00 in offer:70140-0 does not cover our defect handling.

We can offer contract stability for a workable quality and price package.

Best regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our current offer is a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. As an alternative, Hi, thanks for getting back to us. We can do the 1500 ppm and 300 EUR chargeback you proposed, but the price for that setup is €48.50. This alternative is a price of €48.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €300.00 per complaint. This offer is valid for 30 days.

The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. We don't really do cost breakdowns here, but I'll ask the team to check on the lead time for you. If we are taking on these strict quality rules, we definitely need to talk about faster payment to balance things out. Material accounts for about 30 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.body:
